 135 Belief in Weird Things ( 4 Units)
Prerequisites  |  Resources |  Evaluations
109506 LE A00 TuTh 3:30p-4:50p MOS 0114 Brashier, Nadia Marie
FULL
Waitlist(23) 		216
Why do people think that the Earth is flat or that knocking on wood wards off bad luck? False beliefs emerge as byproducts of an otherwise efficient cognitive system. In this course, you will explore how people come to believe in myths, fake news, conspiracy theories, superstitions, astrology, alternative medicine, and alien life. You will learn to use skeptical and scientific thinking to evaluate "weird" (and not so weird) claims.
FI 06/08/2026 M 3:00p-5:59p MOS 0114
